content.subject: Quick thought on legacy payments
content.draft_text:
Hi Chermaine,

I'm Zamp from Zamp Technologies. I'm reaching out because the complexity that comes with expanding payment operations may be an area we could help with.

I read your post about legacy payments and modern issuer processing. I imagine keeping payment records aligned across systems can become increasingly time-consuming.

We build bots that reconcile payment data across systems and flag anomalies, reducing repetitive manual checks.

Curious if this is something your finance team is thinking about right now? Happy to connect for a quick chat.

Best,
Zamp
